title: Be Still and Know
traveler_why: Wren is the Wonderer who knows how to pause and ponder, and tonight’s psalm says be still and know: on a noisy, wiggly, grumpy day, Wren sits quietly with Mom, takes a few slow breaths, and feels the grumpies melt away.
traveler_about: Wren fits tonight because she knows the gift of being still. In Wren’s world today: the day was noisy and Wren felt wiggly and grumpy all over. Mom said, “Let’s be still for a minute.” Wren sat quietly, took a few slow breaths, and felt the grumpies melt away. Just like the psalm says to be still and know Heavenly Father is near, Wren discovered that quiet moments bring His peace.
